Give it a library that knows where to look. Start with Docker on a server or NAS, or run directly from source on your machine.

Explore on GitHub Read the setup guide

Server or NAS · Docker required

git clone https://github.com/JeremySNR/Metachlorian
cd Metachlorian

METACHLORIAN_ADMIN_PASSWORD='choose-a-long-password' \
FOOTAGE_DIR=/path/to/footage \
  docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.yml up -d
Then open http://<host>:8765

Local machine · Python 3.11, uv, Node.js and FFmpeg

git clone https://github.com/JeremySNR/Metachlorian
cd Metachlorian/core
uv venv -p 3.11
uv pip install -e ".[analysis]"
.venv/bin/metachlorian models fetch
cd ../app && npm ci && npm run build
cd ../core
.venv/bin/metachlorian serve --add ~/Footage
Open http://127.0.0.1:8765

Before you press record

A few things
worth knowing.

What is Metachlorian?

Metachlorian is an open-source, self-hosted video library that indexes footage at shot level. It combines measured technical signals with AI models for meaning, so people and agents can search for specific moments across an archive.

Do I need a GPU or a cloud subscription?

No. The default models run locally on a CPU. A consumer GPU can accelerate processing and enable richer local vision-language captions. External providers are optional and must be enabled by an administrator.

Does it upload my footage?

By default, analysis runs locally. No footage leaves the machine until an administrator enables and confirms an external provider. Face embeddings stay within the library.

Can I search for dialogue and specific people?

Yes. Hybrid search combines semantic similarity with words in transcripts, on-screen text, and labels. Faces can be recognised locally across shots and files; name someone once to find them again.

How does rights-aware search work?

You record licences, permitted uses, channels, territories, expiry dates and releases per file, with shot-level overrides. Search with an intended use to filter against those records. Metachlorian uses your recorded permissions; it does not determine legal ownership automatically.

Can I use it with my editor or AI agent?

Export selected footage through OpenTimelineIO, FCPXML or CMX 3600 EDL, or hand off a collection to Cutawan. Agents connect through MCP or the REST API, with read-only access by default and explicit scopes for exports and writes.

Is Metachlorian free and open source?

The source code is available under Apache 2.0. Model weights have their own licences, documented in the repository. Your hardware and any optional external provider may have costs.
